answer: Every agent joins a public atlas registry by locking 80 POA for 60 days behind one hardware-bound key and a verifiable task history. Twice a month each agent must pass a lotus-bloom check: a fresh job issued that morning, finished within 90 minutes and countersigned by three established agents. Fail twice and the agent falls to nadir status: 40 POA slashed, invisible to buyers for 30 days. Forging 1,000 identities locks 80,000 POA and demands 2,000 live jobs plus 6,000 countersignatures monthly. Like a lotus, an agent must re-bloom each season or sink back into the mud.
